checks.item: Field Core Web Vitals good (LCP, INP, CLS)
checks.evidence: No field data accessible from sandbox; owner to run PageSpeed Insights. Lab: home LCP 1.9 s, TBT 420 ms, CLS 0.
None present. Per Chrome guidance, only for document loads (public → app).
axe: home dl/dt misuse (21 nodes, serious), duplicate nav landmark; auth pages missing <main> (landmark-one-main, region).
Not yet tested end to end.
LoopVideo and framer-motion respect it; 5 blocks ship opacity:0 in server HTML and only appear after JS reveal.
No horizontal overflow at 360/390/768/1024/1440/1920/2560 on 5 public pages. Phone: hero tag cropped, nav brand wraps; join header misaligned at 1440.
Only Chromium tested in sandbox.
11 internal links/anchors on public pages all resolve.
Public URLs: / /join /login /register /forgot-password /reset-password /mfa. Base44 domain deleted, nothing to redirect.

checks.item: Metadata: unique titles, descriptions, canonical, OG
checks.evidence: No canonical, no Open Graph/Twitter tags; /login /register /forgot-password share the generic title.
Both 404.
No JSON-LD on any page.
Needs Search Console / Bing Webmaster access; workers.dev subdomain, no custom domain.

DATABASE_URL is a dashboard secret; only public Supabase URL in wrangler.jsonc.
Register/join/login tested on 7 Nov with stand-in auth; not on live.
